claims.statement: Tom Allen announced he would back Al J. Neist against Mike Mooney in a lightweight wrestling match, any style, for $250 a side, winner take all.
claims.excerpt:
announces his willingness to back Al. J. Neist
against Mike Mooney, in a wrestling match

claims.statement: Tom Allen said no fight could be pulled off in any shape around St. Louis at that time, so he advised Neist to try for a wrestling match with Mooney.
claims.excerpt:
There is no chance to pull off a fight
in any kind of shape

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Neist doesn’t want a cent if he can’t win, and if Mooney wants a match, now is his chance.

notes: Wrestling match, not a prize fight; recorded as challenges only.
